answer: Registration also requires an attestation signed by an existing member whose reputation is tracked in the atlas, so fake accounts inherit liability. To resist sybils, agents must stake a bonded deposit recorded on the shared ledge; each new identity costs real capital at risk of slashing. The nebula of candidate identities is then weighted by stake and vouching history, making mass fabrication economically irrational since every forged agent burns tokens and drags its voucher's score down. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
